'吉隆山地海啸' refers to a mountain landslide/debris flow event; '海啸' (tsunami) is used metaphorically here to describe the scale of the debris flow.

english.background_en: Small-scale farmers in Gabès, Tunisia, are reviving traditional agricultural practices to mitigate the effects of climate change and water depletion, as highlighted in a recent RFI report.
english.context_en: In the North African Maghreb region, farmers in Tunisia are increasingly needing to adapt to the impacts of climate change and localized drought. In the southern city of Gabès, small-scale farmers are responding to water shortages and resource depletion by restoring traditional farming methods. This is one of the latest French-language special reports published by RFI Afrique on Sunday, August 16, 2026. The coastal oasis system in Gabès, Tunisia, is among the few of its kind in the world, but it is currently under threat from water scarcity.
english.title_en: Tunisia: Farmers Face Drought from North to South
english.translation_notes_en: The text notes that in Chinese, the country name can be translated as either 突尼斯 or 突尼西亞.

original_zh.context: 在北非马格里布地区，突尼斯（la Tunisie）的耕种者们越来越需要适应气候变化和局部干旱所带来的影响。在该国南部城市加贝斯(Gabès)，小农户们正以恢复传统耕作方式来应对缺水和水资源的枯竭。这是本台法广非洲组（RFI Afrique）于2026年8月16日星期天上网的最新法语特派记者（envoyée spéciale）采访报导之一。突尼斯加贝斯(Gabès)的沿海绿洲体系有世界上少有的之一，但正遭受缺水的威胁。突尼斯的中文国名也有译作突尼西亞（la Tunisie)。
original_zh.title: 突尼斯:耕种者从北到南面临干旱

english.context_en: Beijing, August 29 (Reporter Sun Xiuyan). english.background_en: The National Healthcare Security Administration is attempting to standardize medical data management to facilitate information interoperability across Chinese medical institutions.
english.context_en: The National Healthcare Security Administration recently issued the 'Coding Specification for Medical Insurance Pathology Cloud Indexing.' english.background_en: The metadata states that new government regulations are shifting away from the pre-sale funding model to address debt risks and improve market stability in the real estate sector.
english.context_en: Reuters reports that China issued a series of new regulations on Friday (August 28) aimed at reducing property developers' reliance on pre-sale funds for uncompleted homes. For decades, developers have used the pre-sale model—selling homes before they are built or ready for delivery—to raise capital, a high-debt, high-turnover business model. Since the 2021 real estate crisis, this model has become increasingly unsustainable. Funding shortages and stalled projects have triggered buyer protests and further dampened market confidence. Consequently, authorities hope that the new regulations issued on Friday will control associated risks and revive market confidence.
english.title_en: Major Adjustment to China's Property Pre-sale Model: Mortgage Loans Available Only After Property Delivery, Maximum Loan Term Extended to 40 Years
english.translation_notes_en: 期房 (qifang) refers to uncompleted properties/housing sold off-plan.

original_zh.title: 菲律宾海警回忆中国船只自撞事件；环太平洋军演首次迎来海岸警卫队

english.background_en: The reporter reflects on the U.S.-Japan military alliance while contrasting it with the historical context of the Pearl Harbor attack and personal family history.
english.context_en: On December 7, 1941, Japan launched a surprise attack on Pearl Harbor, drawing the United States into World War II; more than 80 years later, I am at the same harbor, interviewing a Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Rear Admiral about the U.S.-Japan alliance. Within a few days, I witnessed U.S. and Japanese officers and soldiers training together at the Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) exercise; I then walked into the Pearl Harbor memorial park, looking back at the history when the two countries fought each other. More unexpectedly, this journey allowed me to reinterpret my own family story—my grandfather narrowly escaped death twice during World War II, and his experiences finally created an 80-year connection with this moment as I stand at Pearl Harbor.
english.title_en: Reporter's Notebook: Standing at Pearl Harbor—85 Years of Interwoven Time and Space, The History My Grandfather and I Walked Together

original_zh.context: 1941年12月7日，日本偷袭珍珠港，将美国卷入第二次世界大战；八十多年后，我却在同一座港口，采访日本海上自卫队少将谈论美日同盟。短短几天内，我在环太平洋军演见证美日官兵并肩演训；又走进珍珠港纪念园区，回望两国曾经兵戎相见的历史。更意想不到的是，这段旅程让我重新理解自己的家族故事--我的爷爷曾在二战期间两度与死神擦肩而过，而他的经历，最终与我站在珍珠港的这一刻，产生了跨越八十年的连结。
original_zh.title: 记者手记：站在珍珠港--85年的时空交错，我与爷爷共同走过的历史

english.background_en: This piece outlines legal expert Wang Zhu's recommendations for a multi-layered approach to minor protection in digital spaces, prompted by concerns over account misuse and financial risks.
english.context_en: As digital terminals and network services become increasingly integrated into the daily lives of minors, their access to digital services like live streaming and gaming has diversified, bringing concerns over issues like account borrowing, identity theft, and excessive spending in live-streaming environments. Professor Wang Zhu of Sichuan University's Law School argues that the protection of minors in live streaming should not center solely on "whether tips can be refunded," but should be examined within a holistic framework of preventing addiction to digital terminals and services, building a real-name digital identity system, strengthening family guardianship, improving platform governance, and coordinating judicial rules. Particularly when minors may borrow adult accounts to access digital services, relying solely on platform-side identification and post-hoc refund mechanisms remains insufficient to fundamentally solve the problem. Platforms must continuously improve identification, spending limits, and risk intervention measures, while also forming more stable and clear institutional arrangements at the level of digital identity origins and collaborative social governance.
english.title_en: Wang Zhu: Coordinate Legal Resources and Digital Identity Governance to Foster Consensus on Protecting Minors in Live Streaming

original_zh.context: 随着数字终端和网络服务日益融入未成年人的日常生活，未成年人接触网络直播、网络游戏等数字服务的渠道更加多元，直播场景下账号借用、身份冒用、过度消费等问题也随之受到关注。四川大学法学院王竹教授认为，网络直播中的未成年人保护不能仅围绕“打赏能否退款”展开，而应放在数字终端和数字服务沉迷防治、网络实名身份体系、家庭监护责任、平台治理以及司法规则协调的整体框架下加以考察。尤其是在未成年人可能借用成年人账号进入数字服务场景的情况下，仅依靠平台端的身份识别和事后退款机制，仍难以从根本上解决问题。平台需要持续完善未成年人识别、消费限制和风险干预措施，但同时还应从数字身份源头和社会协同治理层面形成更加稳定、清晰的制度安排。

english.background_en: Following the death of former Premier Zhu Rongji, expert Kenneth Lieberthal reflects on his legacy as a pragmatic reformer who integrated China into the global economy.
english.context_en: Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji passed away on Wednesday (August 12). In an exclusive interview with VOA, renowned American China expert Kenneth Lieberthal, who served as a senior director for Asian affairs on the National Security Council during the Clinton administration and had numerous interactions with Zhu, stated that Zhu was 'one of the most impressive leaders' he had ever met—a highly talented, tough-minded, and pragmatic reformer. Lieberthal believes that by leading China's accession to the World Trade Organization and promoting market-oriented reforms, Zhu laid a vital foundation for China's subsequent economic growth; while some of the reforms and WTO commitments he pushed were later weakened or even reversed, Lieberthal argues this should not erase his profound influence on China's development and U.S.-China relations during his tenure.

original_zh.context: 中国前总理朱镕基星期三(8月12日)去世。曾在克林顿政府国家安全委员会担任亚洲事务高级主任、并多次与朱镕基接触的美国知名中国问题专家李侃如(Kenneth Lieberthal)在接受美国之音专访时说，朱镕基是他见过的“最令人印象深刻的领导人之一”，是一位才华出众、作风强硬而又务实的改革者。李侃如认为，朱镕基主导中国加入世界贸易组织并推动市场化改革，为中国此后的经济增长奠定了重要基础；尽管他推动的部分改革和入世承诺后来被削弱甚至逆转，但这不应抹去他在任期间对中国发展及美中关系产生的深远影响。

english.background_en: RFI reports that legal scholars are criticizing a recent court ruling against the Hong Kong Alliance, arguing it creates a dangerous legal precedent by extending the reach of the Chinese Constitution into Hong Kong.
english.context_en: The Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China (the Alliance), which has promoted redress and held commemorations for the June 4th incident for over 30 years, along with its final leaders Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of 'inciting subversion of state power' by three judges designated under the National Security Law. However, human rights centers argue that the judges' interpretation of the Chinese Constitution is an overreach. Legal scholar Eric Lai pointed out that the verdict shows judges inferred guilt based on political assumptions. More dangerously, he notes, the ruling bypasses the Hong Kong Basic Law to confirm that the Chinese Constitution applies to Hong Kong, potentially opening the door for police to enforce the National Security Law more broadly, easily turning peaceful advocacy into illegal acts, and is expected to significantly alter the international community's view of Hong Kong.
english.title_en: Alliance Case: Legal Scholars Criticize Court for 'Incitement by Speech,' Facilitating Constitutional Application to Hong Kong, and Altering International Perception
english.translation_notes_en: The Alliance (支联会) is the common abbreviated name for the organization. '以言入罪' is a legal idiom meaning 'to convict based on speech'.

original_zh.context: 8月26日发生在喜马拉雅山区中国西藏与尼泊尔边境的泥石流是山洪灾难规模空前，造成巨大的生命与财产损失，目前各国的专家们正在就此一灾难所造成的原因举行分析调查，随着时间的推移，事故原因也日渐明朗，法国知名的地球物理与地貌学家，目前在法国格勒诺布尔-阿尔卑斯大学（Université Grenoble Alpes）下属的法国地球科学研究院（ISTerre）任职的Kristen Cook在接受法国国际广播电台采访时表示根据对卫星图像的研究发现造成此次灾难的原因实际上并非冰川崩塌，而是一次大规模的山体滑坡：冰川位于滑坡体之上，因此随之崩塌。这意味着问题不在于冰川本身的稳定性，而在于基岩的稳定性。她在访谈中表示，科学家们目前正在努力确定是否存

english.context_en: Following a Taiwanese scholar who claimed in a submission that Taiwan and China belong to the same political entity... citing as evidence that the two were connected by a land bridge during the glacial period, the Tricontinental Institute, founded by Vijay Prashad, has now published a long article written by Zang Ruxing. english.background_en: Voice of America Chinese reports on urban resilience drills attended by international observers, framing the event as a signal of Taiwan's self-reliance and international partnerships.
english.context_en: Held in tandem with Taiwan's 42nd Han Kuang Exercises, the '2026 Urban Resilience Exercise' took place on Thursday (August 13) in New Taipei City, adjacent to Taipei. Representatives from various international organizations stationed in Taiwan joined President Lai Ching-te at the site to observe the all-out defense mobilization. Lai Ching-te stated that Taiwan's security and peace in the Taiwan Strait are issues of concern to the international community, and that Taiwan is not facing geopolitical changes alone, but must be prepared, as it is 'impossible to rely solely on others.' The American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) stated that the exercises highlight Taiwan's determination to improve its resilience.
english.title_en: International Representatives Observe Taiwan's Urban Resilience Exercises; AIT: Highlights Determination to Improve Resilience
english.translation_notes_en: “美国在台协会” is officially known as the American Institute in Taiwan (AIT).

english.context_en: On August 28th, ahead of his state visit to Kyrgyzstan and attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping stated in a signed article published in Kyrgyz media that the traditional friendship between China and Kyrgyzstan is a precious shared asset.
